rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: FAOSTAT provides AI assistants with natural language access to UN FAO agricultural statistics through 21 MCP tools covering the full FAOSTAT API. It queries data for 245 countries spanning 1961 to present across agriculture, trade, food security, emissions, and more, with three-tier caching and built-in rate limiting to respect API quotas.
